name: Help & small talk
description: Trouble, health, and the sentences that keep a conversation going.

cards.tip: tasukete is the -te form of tasukeru (help, rescue) + kudasai. On its own, tasukete! is the emergency shout.
michi (road) + ni + mayoimashita (past of mayou, to be lost): 'lost on the road'.
nakushimashita is the past polite of nakusu (to lose). Swap the noun: pasupooto o nakushimashita.

examples.ja: 近くに病院はありますか。
examples.romaji: chikaku ni byouin wa arimasu ka.

cards.tip: byou (illness) + in (institution). Long o on byou. biyouin, with an i, is a hair salon.
yaku (medicine) + kyoku (office). kusuri is the medicine itself. Chains often say doraggu sutoa.
kibun (feeling) + ga + warui (bad, i-adjective) + desu. X ga warui = X is bad. Headache: atama ga itai.
Police. kouban is the neighbourhood police box, the one you will actually find.

cards.ja: アメリカから来ました

examples.ja: アメリカから来ました。アリゾナです。

cards.tip: kara = from. kimashita = came, past of kuru. Country + kara kimashita is the standard origin line.

cards.en: It's my first time in Japan
cards.tip: hajimete = for the first time, same root as hajimemashite. X wa hajimete desu = X is a first for me.
san + kagetsu (counter for months) + imasu (am, for people). A duration takes no particle.

cards.ja: 日本語を勉強しています
cards.tip: benkyou (study) is a noun; + suru makes it a verb. shite imasu = am doing. Many nouns become verbs with suru.
o- + namae (name) is honorific for their name; your own is plain namae. Reply: [name] desu.

cards.en: What do you do for work?
cards.tip: Same o- pattern on shigoto (work). Answer with your job + desu.
ii (good) + desu + ne. ne seeks agreement, like 'isn't it'. The most common listener response.
sou (so) + desu + ka. Falling tone: I see. Rising tone: really? Keeps the other person talking.
ne instead of ka turns it into agreement, or a thinking filler. Casual: sou da ne.

cards.ja: ちょっと待ってください
cards.tip: chotto (a little) + matte (-te form of matsu, wait) + kudasai. Casual: chotto matte.

cards.ja: 写真を撮ってもいいですか
cards.romaji: shashin o totte mo ii desu ka
accept: shashin wo totte mo ii desu ka
cards.tip: -te mo ii desu ka = may I. totte is the -te form of toru (take). Swap the verb: haitte mo ii desu ka, may I come in.

cards.ja: これは何と言いますか
cards.romaji: kore wa nan to iimasu ka
cards.tip: to marks a quotation; nan to iimasu ka = 'what is it called'. Use it to learn any word on the spot.
i-adjective past: tanoshii → tanoshikatta. The tense goes on the adjective; desu stays. oishikatta, same pattern.
